items.a: Mission Residency is boutique, high-touch, personalized, and longitudinal. Dr. Brian remains meaningfully involved: technology extends the mentor rather than replacing the mentor. You learn how strong answers are constructed, practise under realistic pressure, and receive expert analysis before programs see you.
items.changed: Removed the MatchFirst claim pending founder decision. Removed 'students from 2015 still text Dr. Brian in 2024' as unverifiable.

items.q: I have red flags — low scores, a year-of-graduation gap, multiple cycles, limited USCE. Can I still match?
items.a: Many of our students are in exactly that position, and reapplicants are a large part of who we work with. What we can tell you honestly is that a cycle usually fails for reasons that are fixable, and that fixing them means rebuilding how you tell your story rather than repeating the same interview. We will tell you candidly what we think is achievable in your situation before you enrol.
items.changed: REMOVED the specific statistics in the live answer — lowest Step 1 of 191, a 24-year YOG gap, '35 of our 102 documented testimonials', and '100% of completed cycles in that subset matched'. None are substantiated, and the last is an implied outcome guarantee.

items.q: What if I went unmatched, or got no interviews at all?
items.a: Most of our students are reapplicants. We start by diagnosing what specifically went wrong, then build a different application, a different narrative and different program targeting. Repeating last cycle louder does not work.
items.changed: Unchanged in substance — no unsupported claims.

items.q: What does it cost, and how can I pay?
items.changed: REWRITTEN. The live answer carries fully stale pricing and a July 1 deadline that expired two months ago. This answer is generated from live config, so it can never go stale again.

items.q: Is it too late to start preparing this season?
items.a: No. If you have an interview coming up soon, IV Prep Essentials gives you the framework quickly. If you want support that runs the whole season — four Signature Mock Interviews, monthly live hot-seats, ongoing practice and checkups, and program-specific strategy — that is IV Prep Complete.
items.changed: Removed the 360 recommendation (2026-27 capacity is reached) and the 'Pre-Start Orientation begins May or June' line, which no longer applies to a September start.

items.a: No. No coach can guarantee a match. What we commit to is the preparation: the framework, live practice, expert analysis, and strategy.
items.changed: Kept the honest first half. REMOVED the 360 'Forever guarantee' — it is one of three conflicting guarantee statements currently live and needs a single founder-approved definition.

items.q: Do I need to be enrolled in a program to work on my personal statement?
items.a: No. The Personal Statement Intensive is sold on its own and standalone buyers are equally welcome. If you later enrol in Essentials or Complete, ask Admissions about applying credit.
items.changed: NEW — the live FAQ never answers this, and it is a real objection for standalone PS buyers.

items.q: What happens right after I enrol?
items.a: You are onboarded into the program and given your schedule of live sessions. From there the season runs in stages: build the foundation, practise under pressure, get assessed, prepare for real interviews, and keep training through the season.
items.changed: NEW — 'what happens after enrollment' is a required comprehension question and the live FAQ does not answer it.
